schemaNote: Phase 0B staging artifact (Issue #182). NOT a second/competing Master Catalog -- this is an explicitly subordinate, not-yet-integrated candidate pool sourced from an externally-relayed PIZZA DB fetch (see sourceMeta below), kept separate from data/recipes/pizza_master_catalog.json until each entry is independently corroborated. No PIZZA DB descriptive text, image, or page structure is reproduced here -- only dish names (treated as facts about real-world dish existence, same practice as the existing 53-entry catalog) and a canonical-ingredient mapping authored independently by this session. verificationStatus for every entry here is 'external_relayed_pending_independent_verification' -- distinct from every status in the existing catalog's enum (never silently upgraded to game_design_candidate or verified_internal).

None merged; all three kept as distinct entries pending a product identity decision.
